Results (all laps pass the game's Verify and fail one tick sooner):
- desert4: g1-1 key re-timing of the IQN learner's 21.792 s lap gives
  21.720 s, 30 ms faster than the best human (21.750 s).
- winter5: g1-2 stitching 18.374 s against the human's 18.425 s.

  inputs (route mode) 21.846 s on desert4.
- g2-3 fine-tune: held-out tracks 1/5/1 to 10/9/8 of 10.
- Route generalist 90 of 170; trained on generated tracks, 71 of 100 on
  unseen generated tracks (15 before). Memory policy: no effect.

- rl/racing_env.mjs: route mode (reference: 'route'), finishHold and
  missedFinish for the route's finish, crashEnd, shapedReward: 0,
  generated tracks, one message per block decision.
- rl/train_ppo.py: --reference, --memory, --session-max, --carry,
  --target-steps, --rotate-every; env_server, evaluate, lap_bc,
  pretrain_bc, polytrack_env to match.
- IQN: --reference route; g1-2 judge=finish and fallback; search_rollout
  keep=; g2-2 jumps, banked turns, wide roads; g2-3 finetune_run.sh.
- Fix: g1-2 locate() returned tick -1 past the donor lap's end.

- sim/pool.mjs: a child that dies rejects its request with the child's last
  error lines instead of hanging the search (was ideas/shared/pool.mjs, now a
  re-export).
- train_block_specialist*.sh: copy the base model only if the checkpoint is
  missing, so a rerun continues as a new stretch instead of throwing the
  trained specialist away.
- train_ppo.py: save on a clean finish or Ctrl-C, not after a crash.
- env_server / iqn_server: refuse non-numeric arguments (were NaN or 0).
- eval_block_specialist.sh, search_round.sh: say "no such checkpoint"
  instead of reporting a missing copy as 0/10.

  by env_server, rollout_child and ideas/shared/policy.mjs. Both summation
  orders are kept by name, so results are bit-identical.

  checked by rl/polytrack_env.py, which holds the Python indices.
